# Teamwork

Teamwork is a project management platform for planning projects, coordinating tasks, collaborating with teams, and tracking time.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/teamwork/.

## Actions

- **Create Tag**: Create a Teamwork tag, or return the existing installation tag when the same name already exists.
- **Create Task**: Create a task in a Teamwork task list with common scheduling, assignment, estimate, privacy, and tag fields.
- **List Milestones** (read-only): List visible Teamwork milestones by project, status, due-date range, assignee, or text.
- **List People** (read-only): List people visible to the connected Teamwork user for assignment and ownership workflows.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List projects visible to the connected Teamwork user, with focused filters for name, status, company, membership, and archival state.
- **List Tags** (read-only): List Teamwork tags visible to the connected user, optionally filtered by project, item type, name, or usage.
- **List Task Lists** (read-only): List Teamwork task lists, usually within one or more projects, so an agent can place or locate tasks.
- **List Tasks** (read-only): List and filter Teamwork tasks by project, task list, assignee, dates, completion state, or tags.
- **List Time Entries** (read-only): List accessible Teamwork time entries by project, task, person, date range, billing state, or tags.
- **Log Time Entry**: Log time against a Teamwork task with a date, duration, optional start time, description, person, billing state, and tags without changing…
- **Search Teamwork** (read-only): Search across Teamwork projects, tasks, task lists, milestones, people, companies, time entries, and other supported item types.
- **Update Task**: Update selected fields of an existing Teamwork task while leaving omitted task fields unchanged.
